subject.title: feat(memory): add multi-slot memory role architecture

question: Should OpenClaw adopt recall, capture, compaction, dreaming, and userModel—with per-agent overrides and the proposed legacy-memory doctor migration—as the durable public memory plugin contract?
rationale: Tests can verify implementation consistency, but they cannot decide the permanent role taxonomy, whether all five roles and per-agent scope belong in the first public contract, or how long legacy plugin/config compatibility should remain.

options.title: Adopt all five roles
options.body: Approve this taxonomy and per-agent scope after the leaf-contract repair, exact-head proof, and migration documentation are complete.

options.title: Narrow the first contract
options.body: Land only the roles and scope maintainers are ready to support permanently, deferring the rest to follow-up design work.

options.title: Pause for another API
options.body: Keep the single-owner model until a different composition or capability contract is approved.

recommendation.title: Adopt all five roles
recommendation.body: Approve this taxonomy and per-agent scope after the leaf-contract repair, exact-head proof, and migration documentation are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available current-main history signal across the central plugin, memory-state, and Control UI surfaces, although the consolidated history makes this routing low confidence.
